title: More models through the text API
summary:
More models and image options arrived alongside clearer feed controls, better docs, and a growing collection of community-built apps.

Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash Thinking joined the text API, followed by Hormoz 8B for chat. The model list also gained DeepSeek R1 Full, and LlamaGuard 7B AWQ became available for safety classification.

The turbo image model was enabled with prompt enhancement and a 768-pixel maximum side length. Image prompts gained LlamaGuard classification, while feed filtering now accounts for additional maturity flags.

Text requests gained `private=true` to keep responses off the public feed. Feed event metadata and OpenAI-style response formatting were refined, SSE examples were added, and the vision docs now distinguish models that accept image inputs from those that do not.

The showcase and project lists gained the underwater adventure Abyss Ascending, Pal Chat, Pollinations.DIY, Titan-GPT, PolliSonic, and urSapere AI. The pollinations.diy browser coding assistant also joined the monorepo, bringing chat, editing, a terminal, and a preview together.
